metadata.case_name: MAK CHI KEUNG v. LAI KAM PIU T/A 錦記廢紙五金

plaintiff.expected_occupation_after: car park attendant or security guard

injuries.description: Right below elbow amputation (complete right hand amputation at the wrist joint; ultimately right below elbow amputation).
source: Examination showed complete right hand amputation at the wrist joint.
As a result, his right forearm from below the elbow was severed.
but reattachment failed, and on 18 July 2007 right below elbow amputation was finally performed.
injuries.icd_description: Traumatic amputation at level between right elbow and wrist

manifestations.description: loss of right hand function after injury and amputation
very sensitive over certain areas on the anterior surface of the stump
feeling pain of the right hand in his sleep
limitation on movement of the right upper limb causing inconvenience to his daily life

treatments_received: PYNEH’s DOT immediately performed replantation surgery of the right hand
multiple salvage procedures including vascular repair surgeries and debridement of the wound
right below elbow amputation (performed on 18 July 2007)
further debridement of wound, stump revision and skin graft until 7 August 2007
discharged on 14 August 2007 with Specialist Outpatient Clinic follow-up arranged
referred to PYNEH’s prosthetic and orthotic department for prosthetic fitting and management
cosmetic hand prosthesis prescribed and fitted on 21 February 2008
attended PYNEH’s POD 5 times between December 2007 and December 2008 for prosthesis adjustment and prosthetic management
regular follow up at PYNEH’s Specialist Outpatient Clinic and prosthetic and orthotic department
treatments_future: Myoelectric prosthesis with i-Limb hand combination (prosthesis components with a lifespan of about 3 years)
regular inspection/repair of prosthesis (2-3 times a year)

losses.description: loss of right hand function after injury and amputation
his injuries resulted not only in serious physical but also cosmetic disability

losses.category: Loss of ability to do domestic tasks
losses.description: he cannot slice a fish, open canned food or hold a bowl of rice or glass of water
